lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots located posterior to the gills, notably featuring a central cluster of four primary maxima in a roughly rectangular orientation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that cross the lateral axis and intersect with the primary spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature situated on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a pronounced vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Observation of two secondary biological entities (remoras) in close proximity: one located on the ventral surface below the mid-section and another positioned immediately posterior to the first dorsal fin.
